groups.saying_opens: ولكن عمه كان لا يقول ذلك
قال ابن مسعود أتجعلون عليها التغليظ

notes: Two sayings, each with its own transmitter: Ibn Abi Layla's remark in the story (saying 1, the last link is the speaker) and Ibn Mas'ud's ruling reached through Malik (saying 2).
«أو مالك بن عوف» gives two alternatives for the same man: the text does not say which name is right, so both stand in one level.
«وقال أيوب عن محمد لقيت أبا عطية» names a different transmitter for the Malik part: a variant group, not a route.
«عبد الله» is written bare (occurrence 1 of the word) and is not completed (rule 9). «عبد الله بن عتبة» is the subject of the story, not a link.
